data.indexCnDesc: 中证光伏产业指数从主营业务涉及光伏产业链上、中、下游的上市公司证券中，选取不超过50只最具代表性的上市公司证券作为指数样本，以反映光伏产业上市公司证券的整体表现。
data.indexEnDesc: CSI Photovoltaic Industry Index is composed of no more than 50 A-Share securities which engaged in photovoltaic industrial chain as the constituents. The index is to measure the performance of the photovoltaic industry.
